## Use of externally-controlled format string

Format string depends on a [user-provided value](1).

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/488)

## Incomplete multi-character sanitization

This string may still contain [<script](1), which may cause an HTML element injection vulnerability.

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/483)

## DOM text reinterpreted as HTML

[DOM text](1) is reinterpreted as HTML without escaping meta-characters.

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/481)

## DOM text reinterpreted as HTML

[DOM text](1) is reinterpreted as HTML without escaping meta-characters.

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/482)

## Polynomial regular expression used on uncontrolled data

This [regular expression](1) that depends on [a user-provided value](2) may run slow on strings starting with '<' and with many repetitions of '<'.

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/489)

## Log injection

Log entry depends on a [user-provided value](1).

[Show more details](https://github.com/ogabasseyy/Baci/security/code-scanning/498)
